description: Glass Dynamic Island-style pill for Windows with media controls, mirrored notifications, file tray, downloads, Bluetooth battery, and live assistant panels.
notes: Uses the publisher's official x64 portable ZIP, not DynamicWinSetup.exe or the Microsoft Store package. The verified v4.2.3 archive expands to a top-level Halo folder containing Halo.App.exe, Halo.Hooks.exe, and Halo.Settings.exe; Halo.App.exe is the primary WinExe declared by src/Halo.App/Halo.App.csproj. Scoop's extract_dir selects the verified Halo folder, and the shim/shortcut target the main app.

The extracted package includes the .NET runtime: it contains coreclr.dll, hostfxr.dll, hostpolicy.dll, and System.Private.CoreLib.dll. Halo.App.runtimeconfig.json lists Microsoft.NETCore.App 9.0.18, and Halo.Settings.runtimeconfig.json lists Microsoft.NETCore.App and Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App 9.0.18 as included frameworks. No separate .NET Desktop Runtime suggestion is required.
The official v4.2.3 DynamicWinPortable.zip SHA-256 was verified against the GitHub Release asset digest. The setup executable is not run; Scoop only extracts the portable archive.
